'''2011 Minnesota State Championship Matt Scott DS Hoth''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Scott]] at [[2011 Minnesota State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth (Dark)|Hoth-D-hoth.gif|label=Hoth}}
* '''Deck name:''' Bantha Mafia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
